2) ACH micro-deposit: we can kick off a micro-deposit test as soon as our finance team verifies the bank stub. Typical turnaround is 24–48 business hours after verification.

3) Required fields for our payments portal (please see the attached sample CSV):
   - payee_name
   - bank_routing (ACH)
   - bank_account_last4
   - currency
   - invoice_amount
   - PO_NUMBER (preferred)
   - remittance_email

Action items for Evergreen:
- Confirm you can send invoices with header "PO_NUMBER" (or confirm we should map "PO_REF").
- Confirm preferred test date window for ACH (early next week works for us).

Ben (cc'd) will own the PO tie-in on our side. I'll hand this to FinOps once you confirm the mapping.

Best,
